#ESRWIKI	2
PAGE	welcome	Welcome	Wiki
ENTRY	Introduction	Welcome to Eastern Sun Resurrected
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	ESR is a massive overhaul of Diablo 2. While at its core it is still Diablo II, there are many more new systems, items, and progression methods to discover. Difficulty is rescaled, monsters are harder and more intelligent, skills are reworked, and it is easy to become overwhelmed. While this Wiki has a lot of information it is simply impossible to contain everything the game has to offer within it. Please refer to the official documentation on EasternSunResurrected.com and the Discord.
ENTRY	Starting your journey	Welcome to Eastern Sun Resurrected
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Open your Starter Pack and Weapon Crate before leaving town. They hold a Noob's Odd Charm and a Kill Ledger that tracks kills for permanent bonuses. Keep them in your charm inventory at all times. Charms only work from the charm inventory button in your inventory panel (or a bound key from the menu). You also start with a an Elixir of Skill, an Introductory Book, and your class's chipped gem for Skill Forging. If you lost your Starter Pack use A Tome of Town Portal and a Tome of Identify in the cube to make a new one.
ENTRY	Death, Respec and Undoing Choices	Welcome to Eastern Sun Resurrected
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Alt+click a + button on the character screen to respec, spending one use from a limited counter; refill it by cubing 4 Dragon Stones into a Token of Absolution. Dying costs some experience and gold but no gear, and costs no experience at all inside a map boss area. Most early gear choices can be undone: remove anything from a socket by transmuting the item with a Key (does not work for Gemwords but will for Runewords). You can remove a Forging craft by transmuting the item with 3 Thawing Potions.
ENTRY	Campaign Progression	Normal: Difficulty
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	ESR has changed the campaign layout to make things more streamlined than Vanilla. Some areas have less levels before you progress and some have bypasses all together
LINE	T	
LINE	T	Be aware that some zones in the campaign will be designated as End Game zones (which will display on screen). It is recommended when starting out for the first time to bypass these areas as none of them are required to progress and they are very difficult.
LINE	T	
LINE	T	Act 2:
LINE	T	Traveling through the desert is optional. The sewers entrance by the docks is a hub to the Horadric Staff pieces, one entrance to the Maggot Passage towards the Maggot Lair. Another entrance to the Temple Passage. Follow that to Temple Passage 2 and you will find the arena for the Amulet.
LINE	T	
LINE	T	Act 3:
LINE	T	Find Khalim's Eye in the Spider Cave, if you find the Great Marsh path away until you find the waypoint for the Spider Forest (which gives you access to the Flayer Tunnel) or naturally arrive in the Flayer Jungle. Keep moving on until you find the next zone or the Flayer Jungle waypoint which has an entrance directly to the Sewers. Upper Kurast has the entrance to both the Sewers and Flayer Dungeon for Khalim's Brain and Heart.
LINE	T	
LINE	T	Act 5:
LINE	T	Proceed normally through Frigid Highlands and the Arreat Plateau, which leads directly to the Frozen River. Rescue Anya and talk to her in town. Through the red portal and kill Pindleskin, which leads you to the Frozen Tundra.
ENTRY	What's worth looting?	Normal: Difficulty
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Pick up more rather than less, you have essentially infinite stash space. Most ESR materials become near-free stocker points. Always keep Ancient Decipherers, Dragon Stones, Ancient Scrolls, Ancient Coupons, Wild Cards, runes, Decals, gems, crystals, organs, Socket Donuts, Worldstone Shards, and any Unique charm. Keep jewels, gems, magic/rare charms, rings and amulets, unwanted set/unique gear, and rejuvenation potions while you're still learning the systems. Plain white, magic or rare weapons and armor are usually safe to sell, unless you're eyeing them for a runeword's socket count.
LINE	T	
LINE	T	Loot filters are available in-game or through the ESR launcher. The ESR launcher offers more loot filter features you may be more familiar with from other ARPGS.
ENTRY	Rune Families	Normal: Difficulty
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	ESR has five rune-like socketables that mostly convert into each other: ES runes (ESR's own line, drop from the start), Decals (stand in for vanilla runes; a Decal plus its named ES rune makes an LoD rune), LoD runes (make vanilla runewords like Enigma, with ESR stats), the Null Rune (a Wo Rune plus a Full Rejuvenation Potion, reversible), and Kanji runes (made from a Null Rune plus crystals, strong late-game socketables). Two of the same rune cube up a grade; one rune alone cubes down a grade.
ENTRY	Runewords and Gemwords	Normal: Difficulty
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Put the right socketables, in the right order, into an allowed white base with the right socket count -- same as vanilla. ESR runewords use ES runes and often have low level requirements; LoD runewords keep vanilla names like Enigma but with ESR stats (check which rune family a card shows, since some names exist in both); gemwords use gems instead of runes. Trying one costs nothing -- a Key in the cube returns every rune and the base. Farm the Countess early: she has her own rune drop on every difficulty.
ENTRY	Ancient Coupons and Wild Cards	Normal: Difficulty
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Most vanilla uniques don't drop directly in ESR -- you find Ancient Coupons instead, each naming one unique and its base. Three matching coupons (or two plus Wild Cards) cube into that unique; these coupon uniques are reworked and usually stronger than ESR's own uniques. Spare coupons convert into Wild Cards or, with a Randomizing Stone, into a random coupon. Check a unique's stats on the Uniques page before spending coupons on it.
ENTRY	Cube Basics	Nightmare
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Almost every ESR upgrade and craft is a cube recipe. On the official Cube Recipes page, Any means any item of that kind, underlined materials in an output are handed back to you, and items like Keys or Scrolls often act as switches that pick a recipe variant. A recipe can silently do nothing if the item has a Forging (discussed later), if Dragonstoning (Crafting system - see Wiki D-Stones) has hit its level-requirement cap, or if the item is Branded. You can bind a hotkey to transmute in the cube.
ENTRY	Adding and Removing Sockets	Nightmare
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	A Key in the cube pops every socketable out of an item for free, keeping both the item and its contents. To add sockets, cube a Socket Donut with gems for white items ((grade of the gem required depends on the item's tier). Use it directly on magic, rare, set or unique gear for a fixed number of sockets based on rarity. Socketing a white item rebuilds it, losing ethereal/superior bonuses, unless you use Secret Recipe 16 (weapons) or 17 (armor) instead. Lucion's Essence (end game jackpot find) adds sockets to magic/rare/crafted/set/unique gear without needing gems at all.
ENTRY	Forging	Nightmare
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Forging adds one extra, removable bonus to gear. Skill (one class's skills, picked by chipped gem color), All Skill (a Maple Leaf plus any chipped gem), Stat (life, cast rate, resists, etc.), Rune (two identical ES or Kanji runes), or Aura (amulets only, via an Aura Stone). An item holds only one Forging at a time. Remove it with 3 Thawing Potions to get the materials back (a Wo Forging can never be removed). Most reroll recipes ignore forged items, so remove a Forging before rerolling. Check the wiki for more Forging recipes
ENTRY	Noob's and Veteran's Odd Charm	Nightmare
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Your starting Noob's Odd Charm has one socket, fill it with whatever helps now. Secret Recipe 49 (nrequires the identified Ancient Scroll 49, 7 rare charms, a Maple Leaf and an Elixir) upgrades it into a Veteran's Odd Charm, which can then take up to 3 sockets via a Socket Donut plus a Perfect Gem each. Match its socket count to any runeword or gemword that allows a charm base.
ENTRY	Secret Recipes	Nightmare
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Each Secret Recipe needs its matching identified Ancient Scroll in the cube, and the scroll comes back every time, so once you have the scroll you have 'learned' the recipe. Cube an unidentified scroll with an Ancient Decipherer to reveal its number. Check recipes by clicking the button inside your cube.
ENTRY	Surviving Hell	Hell
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	The jump from late Nightmare into Hell is the steepest part of the campaign: resistances take a -150 penalty, monsters gain +7 skill levels, and life/mana leech become much weaker. Before you go in, get your resistances back to cap (plus some physical/magic resist if you can), boost life and damage through Forging and D-Stoning, and plan a way past elemental immunities such as a Conviction aura or Lower Resist charges. Farm Nightmare's special areas for materials first, and adjust the Players setting to match your comfort level.
ENTRY	Order of Enhancements	Hell
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	ESR stacks many upgrades on one item, and the order matters: socket a white base first (it gets rebuilt), reroll before upgrading (rerolled uniques lose added sockets), then apply Forging (safe to undo later, but rerolls ignore forged items), then D-stoning or gem melding (permanent), then Tinkering, then Corruption and Anointment (Corruption can brick the item into a random rare), and legendary consumables last of all, since several of those lock the item for good.
ENTRY	Dragon Stones and Anvil Stones	Hell
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Dragon Stones are ESR's workhorse material. Cubing a Dragon Stone alone cycles it through 8 forms (Holy Symbol, Blackmoor, Forging Hammer, Crushed Gem, Spider's Silk, Tyranium Ore, Void Shard, back to Dragon Stone), each used by different recipes. Anvil Stones are used for Forging and come from 4 Dragon Stones plus a Perfect Gem, or from Multi Stocker points. Don't D-stone a placeholder item; D-stoning is permanent even though Forging isn't. Keep in mind D-stoning an item ADDS level requirements, and you can craft them past your current level rendering it unusable to you
ENTRY	After Hell Baal	After Baal
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	There's no fixed order after Hell Baal, but a common path: farm Hell's special areas, then Naraku and Nihlathak's Domain (the hardest special areas, and a source of tier-1 Endgame Maps), then start your first Ascendancy via 5 Hell superuniques, then chase Diablo Clone and Uber Tristram for Annihilus and the Hellfire Torch, then settle into the Endgame Maps loop -- the main endgame grind and the only source of mythical uniques. After any endgame boss kill you get 60 seconds to cube your Kill Ledger for a permanent bonus.
ENTRY	Endgame Maps and Keys	After Baal
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Cube an Endgame Map alone in Act 5 Hell to open its zone and boss. There are 5 tiers; 3 of the same map upgrade to the next tier, and a Randomizing Stone can reroll one. Map bosses drop higher maps, Orbs of Anointment, Weapon Mastery Tokens, and keys -- Pandemonium keys (Terror, Hate, Destruction) convert into each other in the cube and open a portal to one of three uber bosses, whose drops together open Uber Tristram. Maps are the only source of mythical uniques, some from one specific boss only.
ENTRY	Ascendancies	After Baal
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	An Ascendancy Stone is a charm that grants a whole subclass. Kill 5 special Hell superuniques (one each in Acts 1, 2 and 3, two in Act 5) for their elemental orbs, cube those into an Orb of Creation, then cube it with colored Blemished gems -- the color combination picks your ascendancy. Later tiers upgrade the stone through endgame challenges (Nihlathak on Hell, all 3 Uber Tristram bosses in one minute, Primordial Soulstones, a tier-5 map boss) done in any order. You can wear only one stone at a time, and must re-equip it after every death.
ENTRY	Corruption and Anointment	After Baal
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Corruption cubes an item with a Worldstone Shard, then cubes it again for a random strong bonus -- but it can also turn the item into a random rare, so only corrupt what you can afford to lose (Astrogha's Petrified Heart clears a bad corruption's status, keeping the bonus, so you can try again). Anointment uses an Orb of Anointment instead, and its random bonus can never brick the item. Both come after Forging and D-stoning in the upgrade order, and both are fed primarily by terror zones and Endgame Maps.
ENTRY	Unique Charms	After Baal
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Unique charms only work from the charm inventory, and only one of each major one (Annihilus, Hellfire Torch, etc.) counts at a time. Annihilus drops from Diablo Clone (spawned by selling Devil's Food); the Hellfire Torch drops when all 3 Uber Tristram bosses die in the same game. A Standard of Heroes upgrades one charm once; the three uber-boss organs anoint one charm once. Spare unique charms convert into Maple Leaves (via a Key and any Rejuvenation Potion) instead of sitting dead in your stash.
PAGE	ascendancy	Ascendancy	Wiki
ENTRY	Ascendancies	
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Ascendancies are powerful specializations that shape how you play, granting unique skills and bonuses. Ascendancies are granted through a special charm called the Ascendancy Stone that can only be obtained after completing several special encounters.
LINE	T	​
LINE	T	Ascendancy stones can be further upgraded (meaning you can further ascend) by completing specific challenges, some of which are tied to very hard endgame content.
LINE	T	​
LINE	T	There are 5 ascendancy tiers you can attain, each challenge being harder than the previous one, but the bonuses being stronger as well. Ascendancy Stones cannot be shared to other characters. You can only have one ascendancy stone equipped at any time. Needless to say, each tier can only be achieved once. However, you can achieve them in any order.
LINE	T	​
LINE	T	Ascendancy stones cannot be modified by regular means (they cannot be corrupted, anointed, broken down for maple leaves etc.).
LINE	T	​

LINE	T	​

LINE	T	​

ENTRY	Higher Tier Challenges	
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Tier 2:
LINE	T	The second tier is achieved by killing Nihalthak in his domain on hell difficulty and transmuting the ascendancy stone with itself. You need to transmute it while you have the swirls active on your character.
LINE	T	​
LINE	T	Tier 3:
LINE	T	The third tier is achieved by killing all of Uber Tristram bosses within one minute of each other without dying and transmuting the ascendancy stone with a Maple Leaf. Even if you have the swirls active on your character after you killed the last boss, it will not work if it passed more than 1 minute since you killed the first one.
LINE	T	​
LINE	T	Tier 4:
LINE	T	The fourth tier is achieved by collecting 10 Primordial Soulstones that drop from any endgame map boss. You can only transmute one Primordial Stone at a time with the Ascendancy Stone. Once you have captured 10 Primordial Soulstones in the Ascendancy Stone, you will be able to transmute it with 2 Maple Leaves to ascend to tier 4.
LINE	T	​
LINE	T	Tier 5:
LINE	T	The fifth tier is achieved by killing any tier 5 map boss and transmuting the ascendancy stone with 3 Maple Leaves. You need to transmute it while you have the swirls active on your character.
LINE	T	​

ENTRY	How to Acquire Elemental Runes	
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Elemental Runes cannot be found as monster drops - they must be crafted using the Horadric Cube.
LINE	T	1. Cube a Wo Rune together with a Full Rejuvenation Potion to create a Null Rune.
LINE	T	2. Hell difficulty Treasure Goblins drop Crystal Shards. Cube 5 matching Crystal Shards to upgrade them into a Flawed Crystal, then cube 5 matching Flawed Crystals to upgrade into a named Catalyst Stone.
LINE	T	3. Cube the Catalyst Stone together with a Null Rune to create the matching Elemental Rune.
LINE	T	Heaven Rune and God Rune instead require four different Catalyst Stones together with a Null Rune.
LINE	C	IngredientsResult
LINE	R	Null RuneFrozen Soulÿc3Moon Rune
LINE	R	Null RuneBleeding Stoneÿc3Fire Rune
LINE	R	Null RuneDark Azuriteÿc3Water Rune
LINE	R	Null RuneTomb Jadeÿc3Wood Rune
LINE	R	Null RuneSolid Mercuryÿc3Metal Rune
LINE	R	Null RuneBitter Peridotÿc3Earth Rune
LINE	R	Null RuneEnigmatic Cinnabarÿc3Sun Rune
LINE	R	Null RuneBurning Surphurÿc3Thunder Rune

PAGE	endgame-maps	Endgame Maps	Endgame
ENTRY	Overview	
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	Warning: endgame map zones are much more difficult than all other content they require extremely well defined builds.
LINE	T	Endgame map zones can be accessed by transmuting map items by themselves in act 5 hell. There are a total of 18 map items across 5 tiers.
LINE	T	Each tier has 4 different map zones, except tier 5 which has only 2 maps with unique and extremely difficult boss encounters.
LINE	T	Map items can drop from nihlathak domain superuniques. Each superunique boss has a 5% chance to drop a tier 1 map.
LINE	T	Map items can also drop from champions and unique monsters in level 96 terrorized zones.
LINE	T	Map items can also be acquired as a rare drop in endgame map zones themselves, which will be your main source if you run map zones regularly
LINE	T	Regular monsters in maps can drop a map one tier higher than the map tier they're killed in. You can also upgrade maps at a 3:1 ratio.
LINE	T	It is recommended that your build has at least 5k hp, max resistances, some physical resist and other defensive layers in order to survive.
LINE	T	Rewards that are expressed in average chance mean that those rewards can be increased by up to 100% at players 8. For example, An ancient has 50% chance to roll a key drop twice, so on average you get one key, but increasing player number to 8 will make him have almost 100% chance to drop 2 keys.
LINE	T	Endgame maps can become terrorized and one map of each tier will be terrorized at one time (except tier 5, which are terrorized both at the same time, independent of others).
LINE	T	Endgame maps can be terrorized on normal and nightmare difficulties too, but it is not intended. This cannot be fixed due to engine limitations.
LINE	T	Terrorized bosses always drop a Worldstone Shard (except tier 5 bosses due to an engine limitation).

LINE	T	Weapon mastery can be achieved by transmuting a ÿcHWeapon Mastery Token ÿcN that can drop from ÿcHCorrupted ZakarumÿcN and endgame map bosses (25% chance, not scaled by /players).
LINE	T	ÿcHCorrupted ZakarumÿcN are deadly unique enemies that you will encounter ramdomly in the campaign across nightmare and hell that have a chance to drop a weapon mastery token (up to 75%, not scaled by /players) and an increased chance to drop uniques and weapons.
LINE	T	Once transmuted, the token is ÿcOawakenedÿcN and you can properly apply it to the weapon by transmuting it with the weapon and a few ingredients.
LINE	T	Weapon mastery specializations are not meant to add power creep or necessarily make the character stronger, but change how skills work mechanically or offer new itemization paths for characters.
LINE	T	You can only apply one weapon mastery per weapon. Weapon masteries do not stack (for dual wielding cases) unless explicitly stated otherwise.
LINE	T	Weapon mastery can be applied to any class weapon, regardless of its tier (works on exceptional, elite and mythical bases as well).

PAGE	vessel-of-souls	Vessel of Souls	Endgame
ENTRY	Overview	
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	ÿcOVessel of SoulsÿcN is a special mythical unique amulet that can consume 5 organs at a time to get various bonuses based on the organs consumed.
LINE	T	The vessel spawns with 2000 souls and every recipe consumes a number of souls. There are four tier of stats, each tier has specific properties, as listed below.
LINE	T	You need to complete each tier in order to be able to advance to the next tier (e.g. you cannot use tier 3 recipes unless you have completed the tier 1 and 2 first).
LINE	T	Every tier has a capacity of 5 recipes, except tier 4 (the last one), which is a bit more special.
LINE	T	You will be notified when each tier is exhausted with a special orange text on the item.
LINE	T	Once you exhaust all tiers, you can transform the ÿcOVessel of Souls ÿcN into 1 out of many possible mythical weapon bases.
LINE	T	ÿcOVessel of SoulsÿcN is also the only equippable unique item in the game that can be anointed.
LINE	T	ÿcOVessel of SoulsÿcN cannot be corrupted while it has unconsumed souls.
LINE	T	ÿcOVessel of SoulsÿcN cannot be worn as an amulet. You need to complete its crafting process and transform it into a weapon first.

PAGE	kill-ledger	Kill Ledger	Endgame
ENTRY	Overview	
BLOCK	0						0
LINE	T	The ÿcOKill LedgerÿcN is a special book that keeps tracks of the amount of enemies you have killed.
LINE	T	In addition to keeping track, the ledger can be imbued with various bonuses once you reach specific kill tresholds.
LINE	T	The ÿcOKill LedgerÿcN can also be used to capture the souls of endgame map bosses. Killing map bosses allows you to transmute the ledger for special bonuses.
LINE	T	The bonuses aren't as important or game changing as the ascendancy ones, but they are generally easier to obtain and are mostly symbolic, meant to track your progress.
LINE	T	The kill bonuses need to be completed in order. Trying to transmute for all skills without all the previous bonuses won't work, for example.
LINE	T	The ÿcOKill LedgerÿcN is also essential for the skills' random effects to work, so you need to ÿcRkeep it in your charm inventory at all timesÿcN.
LINE	T	ÿcPThe boss bonusesÿcN can be completed in any order.
LINE	T	The ÿcOKill LedgerÿcN ÿcRcannot be transferedÿcN between characters.
LINE	T	Needless to say, each bonus is attainable only once.

LINE	C	SkillDescription
LINE	R	Arrow, Fire/Cold/Lightning/Magic Enhanced ArrowA simple arrow that deals 100% weapon damage and that cannot pierce. The elemental enhanced variants convert 100% of physical damage to the corresponding damage type.
LINE	R	Axe Throw, Fire/Cold/Lightning/Magic Enhanced AxeA simple axe that deals 100% weapon damage and that cannot pierce. The elemental enhanced variants convert 100% of physical damage to the corresponding damage type.
LINE	R	Fire/Cold/Lightning/Poison/Magic/Wind SurgeA small area of effect instant spell damage skill. Each skill gets synergy bonuses from all spells of their attuned element (e.g. Fire Surge gets synergy bonuses from all direct damage fire spells, like Flameburst or Volcano). Unlike other procs, those inherit the bonus damage from crossbows.
LINE	R	Elemental SurgeA fire, cold, lightning, magic and wind surge 5 in 1.
LINE	R	Fire/Cold/Lightning/Magic/Wind BrandA skill that attaches a brand to the target enemy and deals 100% weapon damage converted to the respective element after a delay of 0.4 seconds.
LINE	R	Fire/Cold/Lightning/Magic/Non-Elemental Spike NovaA skill that releases a 100% weapon damage converted to the respective element 64 spikes nova.
LINE	R	Time LapseA skill that simply heals the user when it procs / is casted. Level = % heal (e.g. level 10 = 10% heal of max life).
LINE	R	Super NovaA 150% weapon damage converted to lightning damage screen wide area of effect nova that knockbacks all enemies.
LINE	R	Spirit of Nature MasteryA passive skill granting 1% physical resist and 5% life (additive with feral mastery bonus) per level.
LINE	R	Warm UpA buff that grants 2% attack speed, 2% movement speed, 2% cast speed, 10% mana regen per level. Also regenerates life equal to ~10 life per second per level.
LINE	R	Blades of Ice/Claws of Thunder/Fists of Fire DischargeProcs that discharge a simulated 3 charges charge up skill when they proc. They take the same synergies as the regular skills. Unlike the Physical finisher discharge procs, those take the level of the proc itself rather than the learned skill.
LINE	R	Fire/Cold/Lightning Damage AuraAura that grants 5% specific Spell Damage to affected party members per level.
LINE	R	Fire/Cold/Lightning Pierce AuraAura that lowers the resistances to the specific element of nearby enemies by 1% per level.
LINE	R	Dragon Fury/Execute DischargeThis comes as a proc on items and when it procs, you get a fully charged, current level (skill level learned, not proc level) Dragon Fury/Execute discharged on the enemy.
LINE	R	Trophy of Physical DamageA buff that grants 800% Enhanced Damage and 50-100 Physical Damage to Attacks. Lasts 20 seconds.
LINE	R	Trophy of SpeedA buff that grants 100% base attack speed and run/walk, 100% Faster Cast Rate, 100% Faster Block Rate and 100% Faster Hit Recovery. Lasts 20 seconds.
LINE	R	Trophy of Spell DamageA buff that grants 300% Spell Damage. Lasts 20 seconds.
LINE	R	Trophy of SustenanceA buff that grants 150% Increased Maximum Life and Mana. Lasts 20 seconds.
LINE	R	Trophy of ResistancesA buff that grants 100% Elemental and Poison Resistances and 50% Physical and Magic Resistances. Lasts 20 seconds.
LINE	R	Trophy of StatsA buff that grants 150 to All Attributes. Lasts 20 seconds.
LINE	R	Trophy of SkillsA buff that grants 10 to All Skills. Lasts 20 seconds.
LINE	R	DeliriumA buff that grants 50% Bonus to All Attributes, 15 Life on Striking and Curse Immunity (does NOT clear present curses) for 4 seconds.
LINE	R	Fire/Cold/Lightning FlashA multiple shot type attack that fires 1 fire/cold/lightning bolt + 1 per 5 levels in a cone. Each bolt has 100% inherent pierce chance and converts all physical damage to its respective element. Deals 125% weapon damage.
LINE	R	ShacklesA curse that slows enemy movement speed by 100% + 5% per level and total armor by 20% + 1% per level.
LINE	R	Heat DeathA spell that deals 50% of nearby enemies' current health as fire damage instantly. Area of effect is 10 + 2/3 per level yards.
LINE	R	Absolute ZeroA spell that deals 50% of nearby enemies' current health as cold damage instantly. Area of effect is 10 + 2/3 per level yards.
LINE	R	OverloadA spell that deals 50% of nearby enemies' current health as lightning damage instantly. Area of effect is 10 + 2/3 per level yards.
LINE	R	SingularityA spell that deals 50% of nearby enemies' current health as magic damage instantly. Area of effect is 10 + 2/3 per level yards.
LINE	R	Death's WebA spell covers the battlefield in spider webs, reducing poison resistance of the enemies that walk over them by 75% and their base movement speed by 100%.
LINE	R	Multiple Shot BallistaSummon a static construct that fires multiple arrows at multiple enemy. The construct inherits your physical attack damage and all your attack modifiers except procs. Can summon an extra ballista for every 50000 defense. Does not scale with trap limit modifier.
LINE	R	Harpoon BallistaSummon a static construct that fires powerful stunning attacks at a single enemy. The construct inherits your physical attack damage and all your attack modifiers except procs. Can summon an extra ballista for every 50000 defense. Does not scale with trap limit modifier.
LINE	R	Lightning CascadeAn attack that fires a lightning bolt towards every enemy on the screen. Each bolt deals 100% weapon damage converted to lightning.
LINE	R	Glacial InfernoA cataclysmic wave of frost that freezes all surrounding monsters for 8 seconds and deals 50% weapon damage as cold damage.
LINE	R	Thunder StarRelease a nova of 5 lightning bolts that spawn shock fields which deal 20% weapon damage as lightning to everyone standing on them.
LINE	R	SpiritstormRelease 1 spirit every 0.2 seconds for 4 seconds that seek nearby enemies and deal 50% weapon damage as magic damage. Each spirit heals for 1% of player's max health on hit.
LINE	R	Dragon's BreathA firestorm clone that takes bonus synergy damage from all fire spells.
LINE	R	TwinkleA skill that summons charged bolts into battle that deal 10% weapon damage as lightning.
LINE	R	Long ShotA missile that deals 100% weapon damage and up to 200% more total damage at maximum range.
